name: Sentinel Faris Kesset
desc:
Sentinel Faris Kesset is a Tiran NPC. She was part of the Shock Trooper division for [The Central Authority](faction:the_central_authority).

She wielded the Duskguard Axe. As signified by her resonance, she was moderately strong.

She was eventually slain by [Titus Fulminus Destellus](entity:titus_fulminus_destellus) and was succeeded by [Sentinel Augustus](entity:sentinel_augustus). Augustus had served as an Operator under Kesset and had been particularly close to her.
